description: Lumio on Thursday unveiled Vision 9 (2026) Smart TVs in India, and Gadgets 360 spoke to CEO Raghu Reddy to understand the brand's moves beyond the screen.
title: How Lumio Is Challenging TV Giants With a “Speed-First” Philosophy

description: OnePlus Nord CE 6 Lite has appeared on Geekbench with model number CPH2943, hinting at an India launch as early as May alongside the Nord CE 6. The listing suggests a MediaTek Dimensity 7400 chipset, 8GB RAM, and Android 16, with Geekbench scores of 1,068 and 2,953. Leaks also point to a 6.7-inch 120Hz display, 7,000mAh battery, and dual cameras. The phone could mark the return of the CE Lite series and may be priced under Rs. 23,000.
title: OnePlus Nord CE 6 Lite Appears on Geekbench With Dimensity 7400 Chip, Android 16

description: South Korea plans to pilot blockchain-based payments for government expenses under a regulatory sandbox. The initiative aims to improve transparency, reduce misuse, and lower costs through tokenised deposits. The move is part of the country’s broader strategy to expand digital asset adoption in public finance.
title: South Korea Plans Blockchain-Based Payments for Government Spending

description: YouTube has introduced a new feature that allows users to effectively turn off Shorts on the mobile app. The update adds a zero-minute option to the Shorts feed timer. As per the video-sharing platform, this allows users to hide the short-form video feed entirely from the interface. The feature is currently rolling out globally. With this move, YouTube is providing users with more control over how much time they spend on the platform.
title: YouTube's New Option Lets Users Effectively Turn Off Shorts From Their Feed

description: Meta’s purported development of an artificial intelligence (AI)-powered facial recognition technology for its future smart glasses has raised concerns among privacy advocates. An open letter signed by 77 organisations working in the privacy and civil liberties space has been published, urging the Menlo Park-based tech giant to stop the development of such a feature.
title: Meta’s Planned Facial Recognition Feature for Smart Glasses Faces Opposition From Privacy Orgs

description: Companies like HP, Canon, and Brother are selling premium laser printers in IndIa with the latest printing technologies, sharp text output and speed. Some are built for small to medium-sized businesses and offer print, copy, and scan functions. Here we have listed some of the best premium laser printers available in India, along with their key features and current prices.
title: Best Premium Laser Printers Available in India

description: Vivo X300 Ultra is set to launch globally on April 24, with Amazon Germany listing its 16GB + 1TB variant at EUR 2,000 (roughly Rs. 2,19,800). Bundles with accessories go up to EUR 3,166 (roughly Rs. 3,47,900), while pre-order offers in select European markets include benefits worth up to EUR 1,309 (roughly Rs. 1,43,800) and discounted accessories. The flagship features a Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chip, a 6.82-inch 144Hz AMOLED display, Zeiss-backed cameras, and a 6,600mAh battery with fast charging.
title: Vivo X300 Ultra Pricing Surfaces Online via Retail Listing in Europe

description: Apple launched the Express Transit Mode in 2019 to offer a higher level of convenience to users while travelling through buses and railways. It allows users to make payments at transit terminals without unlocking their handsets. However, a YouTuber has now demonstrated on video that a vulnerability can be exploited to steal money from an iPhone user's bank account without unlocking the phone. It uses a combination of devices and code modifications to trick the iPhone into thinking that the payment is being made at a transit terminal.
title: Apple Tap-to-Pay Vulnerability Demonstrated on Video as YouTuber Steals $10,000 From a Locked iPhone

description: Amazon launched an AI Store microsite within its e-commerce website and app on Thursday. The new space is dedicated to consumer tech devices that come equipped with artificial intelligence (AI) features and tools. The Seattle-based tech giant said that the AI Store is aimed at helping users discover and make informed decisions when shopping for AI-powered smartphones, laptops, smartwatches, smart TVs, and more.
title: Amazon Launches AI Store to Help Users Discover and Shop AI-Powered Devices

description: Lenovo announced that it will host a launch event in China on May 19. The event will see the launch of multiple new devices, including the Lenovo Legion Y900 AI, Legion Y7000X tablets, and the Legion Y70 smartphone. The Lenovo Yoga Air 14 Ultra and the Legion Y7000X laptops are also scheduled to be launched during the event. The teaser video also indicates that the Motorola Razr Fold will be featured at the event.
title: Motorola Razr Fold, Lenovo Legion Y70 to Launch Alongside Y900 Tablet During Lenovo's May 19 Event

description: Google’s Find Hub lets you locate, lock, or erase a lost Android phone remotely using a browser or another device. After signing in, you can view its location, make it ring, or secure it with a new lock. If recovery is not possible, you can erase all data. The phone must be on, connected to the internet, and have Find Hub enabled. Even if offline, it may show the last known location or use nearby Android devices to help find it.
title: How to Find and Erase a Lost Android Phone Using Find Hub: A Step-by-Step Guide

description: WhatsApp is reportedly developing a new feature designed to help Android users better organise conversations with businesses. It is expected to help users to reduce clutter and spam. WhatsApp currently shows messages from business accounts alongside regular chats in the main chat list. Business messages will reportedly automatically be moved to a dedicated section 24 hours after they are received.
title: WhatsApp Working on Business Chat Filtering Feature That Could Offer Tidier Chat List: Report

description: TotalRecall Reloaded, a tool by cybersecurity researcher Alexander Hagenah, has raised new concerns about Microsoft’s Windows Recall feature. The tool can access Recall data after user authentication, despite Microsoft’s redesigned security measures. Hagenah argues that while storage is secure, the way data is accessed remains vulnerable. Microsoft does not consider this a security issue, saying it aligns with system design. The findings highlight ongoing concerns about privacy risks in features that store detailed records of user activity.
title: Microsoft's Recall Feature Faces Criticism After TotalRecall Reloaded Tool Regains Access to Data

description: The UK’s Financial Conduct Authority has invited feedback from crypto firms as it prepares for new regulations set to roll out in 2027. The consultation aims to improve clarity, competition, and consumer protection while guiding firms on compliance. The move reflects the UK’s efforts to build a structured and transparent crypto ecosystem.
title: UK FCA Seeks Guidance From Cryptocurrency Firms Ahead of 2027 Crypto Rules Rollout

description: Adobe introduced the Firefly AI Assistant on Wednesday, an agentic conversational chatbot that can perform complex design tasks. Available inside the Firefly platform and connected to the Creative Cloud apps, the assistant can both analyse and act on natural language prompts. The company said the tool will help creators automate creative workflows while maintaining context.
title: Adobe’s New Firefly AI Assistant Can Perform Complex Design Tasks With Text Prompts

description: Crimson Desert has surpassed 5 million copies sold. The open-world game has reached the sales milestone in less than a month of its release. Crimson Desert released on PC, Mac, PS5, and Xbox Series S/X on March 19. The game has also received regular updates from Pearl Abyss.
title: Crimson Desert Has Sold Over 5 Million Copies, Pearl Abyss Confirms

description: With Oppo all set to wrap up its Find X9 series with the upcoming launch of the Find X9 Ultra and the Find X9s, early leaks about its successor have already begun surfacing. The next-generation lineup is expected to include three models: the Find X10, Find X10 Pro, and Find X10 Pro Max. A tipster has leaked key specifications of the standard Find X10, hinting at continued usage of the flat OLED screen, while the battery could receive a significant upgrade.
title: Oppo Find X10 Could Feature 8,000mAh Battery and 200-Megapixel Cameras, Tipster Claims

description: Pre-orders for the Motorola Razr Fold will be open until May 3 in the UK, and the shipments will start on May 6. Based on this, the launch is widely expected to take place on May 6. The brand has listed the Motorola Razr Fold for EUR 1,799 (roughly Rs. 2,27,500) for the sole 16GB RAM + 512GB storage option. Buyers can grab it for a discounted price of GBK 1,579 (roughly Rs. 1,99,600). It is available in Pantone Lily White and Pantone Blackened Blue colours.
title: Motorola Razr Fold Launch Date Seemingly Revealed Along With Price and Offers;  Pre-Orders Now Open

description: Lumio refreshed its smart TV lineup in India with the launch of Lumio Vision 9 (2026) and Lumio Vision 7 (2026) on Thursday. The new offerings focus on improving performance, display quality, and content discovery, as smart TV buyers increasingly prioritise speed and usability over just screen size and branding. The Vision 9 (2026) is positioned as a flagship model with a premium feature set, while the refreshed Vision 7 (2026) targets the mid-range segment with upgrades to storage and connectivity.
title: Lumio Vision 9 (2026) Launched in India With 144Hz 4K Screen, Lumio Vision 7 (2026) Tags Along: Price, Features

description: Honor is said to be working on a new smartphone with an 11,000mAh battery. The exact name of the smartphone is not known, but it is speculated to be an Honor Power series smartphone, which could arrive as a successor to the Honor Power 2. The Honor Power 2 was launched with a 10,080mAh battery with 80W wired fast charging support and 27W wired reverse charging support.
title: Honor's Upcoming Smartphone Said to Feature a Larger 11,000mAh Battery

description: A comedy drama about a miserly man trying to reclaim a costly wedding gift that leads to chaos and unexpected twists
title: Toaster Now Streaming Online: Where to Watch Rajkummar Rao and Sanya Malhotra’s Comedy Drama?

description: The lower end of the premium segment is not as exciting as it once was. There is not much to see here, apart from a few new devices that have made it in, mainly due to the ongoing memory crisis. The other devices available under Rs. 40,000 have also made it here because of price cuts. Obviously, not everything is perfect, but there’s still some variety to choose from.
title: Best Mobiles Under Rs. 40,000 in India: From Nothing Phone 4a Pro, OnePlus Nord 6 and More

description: OnePlus Pad 4 will be launched in India on April 30 at 12 pm IST, the tech firm announced on Thursday. As part of the announcement, the company revealed key specifications, features, and design of the upcoming flagship tablet. This comes a couple of days after the company began teasing the unveiling of a new OnePlus Pad series device in the country. Additionally, the dedicated microsites for the tablet on Flipkart, Amazon, and the OnePlus India online store are now live, confirming their availability vie the websites. The upcoming OnePlus Pad 4 is confirmed to pack a 13,380mAh battery.
title: OnePlus Pad 4 India Launch Date Announced; Key Specifications, Design Revealed

description: Bitcoin is trading near $75,000 as strong institutional inflows support prices despite cautious retail activity. Analysts say the market remains range-bound, with macro cues and ETF flows driving sentiment. A breakout above resistance could push prices higher, while support levels remain intact.
title: Bitcoin Holds Steady Near $75,000 as Cryptocurrency Prices Gain Support From Institutional Demand

description: Sony has announced the titles joining PS Plus Game Catalogue in April. Ubisoft's open-world racing title, Crew Motorfest, headlines this month's additions. Game Catalogue wil also add Horizon Zero Dawn Remastered, Football Manager 26 Console, Warriors: Abyss, and more this month.
title: PS Plus Game Catalogue Lineup for April Announced: The Crew Motorfest, Horizon Zero Dawn Remastered and More

description: A suspense-packed Malayalam thriller that unravels hidden secrets behind a mysterious incident.
title: Sambhavam Adhyayam Onnu Now Available for Streaming Online: What You Need to Know

description: Google released its Gemini artificial intelligence (AI) platform as a dedicated app for macOS on Wednesday. This is the first time the Mountain View-based tech giant has introduced the chatbot to a desktop as a native app. Gemini is available to all users, including those on the free tier of the app, as long as they are using a supported version of the operating system.
title: Google Introduces Gemini App to macOS, to Rival ChatGPT and Claude

description: Realme Buds T500 Pro were launched in India at Rs. 2,799 with a first sale discount of Rs. 200. They feature 12.4mm drivers, Hi-Res Audio Wireless, LHDC 5.0, and up to 50dB ANC with adaptive tuning. The earbuds support Bluetooth 6.1 with multi-device connectivity and low latency. They are claimed to deliver up to 56 hours of battery life with the case. Additional features include EQ customisation, live translation, Find My Earbuds, IP55 rating, and a compact, lightweight design.
title: Realme Buds T500 Pro Launched in India With Up to 50dB ANC, Up to 56 Hours Total Battery Life: Price, Features

description: Poco C81 Pro could launch soon, and the smartphone has reportedly appeared on Xiaomi's global website. The listing shows the Poco C81 Pro with 4GB RAM and up to 256GB storage. It is listed with a 6.9-inch LCD panel with a 120Hz refresh rate and a 6,000mAh battery with support for 15W charging. It has a Unisoc T7250 chipset and a 13-megapixel rear camera unit.
title: Poco C81 Pro Unexpectedly Turns Up on Xiaomi's Global Website Along With Key Specifications, Features

description: Apple may introduce an OLED iPad Air in 2027, with Samsung Display expected to begin panel production in late 2026 or early 2027, according to a recent report. The device could launch in the first half of 2027. It is likely to use a lower-cost OLED panel to keep pricing competitive. The move would extend OLED across most of Apple’s tablet lineup, leaving only the standard iPad on LCD, while helping boost OLED demand and strengthening Samsung’s role as a key supplier.
title: Apple's OLED iPad Air to Launch in 2027, Samsung Display to Begin Production Soon: Report

description: Xiaomi 18 Pro has been spotted in a leaked render online, which reveals the rumoured flagship smartphone’s design. The image was shared by a tech commentator via a social media post, in which he claimed that the Xiaomi 18 Pro will be equipped with a new dedicated AI button. The purported Xiaomi 18 Pro render shows that this new physical button will be placed on the right side of the phone. The AI button on the rumoured Xiaomi phone will offer “one-tap” control for connected car features and smart home functionalities.
title: Xiaomi 18 Pro Leak Hints at Dedicated AI Button, Subtle Design Changes

description: Motorola appears to be preparing for the debut of its next-generation foldable series, which includes the Razr 70 and Razr 70 Ultra. Although official details remain under wraps, the Motorola Razr 70 Ultra has appeared on a Chinese certification database. The listing not only hints towards the purported handset’s imminent arrival but also reveals some of its key specifications. It comes shortly after the standard Razr 70 model surfaced on the same platform.
title: Motorola Razr 70 Ultra Display, Battery and Other Specifications Spotted in TENAA Listing

description: Oppo Find X9 Ultra is now available for pre-order in China via the Oppo online store. The company has also listed the smartphone on its website, revealing the upcoming flagship smartphone’s RAM and storage configurations, along with the names of its colour options. The handset will be offered in Polar Glaciers, Rongsha Canyon, and Tundra colourways (translated from Chinese). Moreover, the smartphone will go on sale in the country in 12GB + 256GB, 12GB + 512GB, 16GB + 512GB, and 16GB + 1TB RAM and storage configurations.
title: Oppo Find X9 Ultra Storage Variants, Colourways Revealed as Company Opens Pre-Orders for the Phone

description: Nothing has launched a new app and browser extension called Warp, which enables file-sharing between Android phones and computers running macOS, Windows, and Linux, the London-based smartphone maker announced on Wednesday. Nothing Warp uses a combination of a “lightweight” app and a browser extension, which is only supported on Chromium-based browsers, to share files. The company said it uses the user’s personal Google Drive to transfer images, links, videos, and clipboard text to the user's computer. However, Nothing Warp is claimed not to store any files during the process.
title: Nothing Introduces Warp App Enabling File-Sharing Between Android Phones and Mac
When an Upgrade Finally Feels Worth It: Samsung Galaxy A57 5G

description: Motorola is said to have revised the prices of its tablets in India. According to details shared by a tipster, select models in the Moto Pad 60 series have received updated pricing across configurations. The move appears to impact both Pro and Neo variants of the Motorola Pad, including models that come bundled with a stylus. While the reason behind the revision remains unclear, Motorola joins a growing list of brands that have recently tweaked the pricing of products in the country.
title: Moto Pad 60 Pro and Moto Pad 60 Neo Receive Price Hike in India, Tipster Claims

description: Nvidia has launched GeForce Now in India in early access, allowing users to stream PC games without high-end hardware. The service supports multiple devices and platforms like Steam and Xbox Game Pass. It offers over 4,500 games, including free-to-play and AAA titles, with weekly additions. Powered by RTX 5080 SuperPODs, it supports up to 5K 120fps streaming and low-latency modes. Pricing starts at Rs. 999 for 90 days, with optional storage add-ons. A free tier is expected soon.
title: Nvidia GeForce Now With RTX 5080-Powered Cloud Gaming Hits Early Access in India

description: Oppo has launched the F33 Pro 5G in India earlier today. This new model targeting the mid-range segment will compete with the likes of recently launched OnePlus Nord 6 and Nothing Phone 4a Pro. All three phones fall in the same price range and offer AMOLED displays with a 120Hz refresh rate. Here's a comparison of the Oppo F33 Pro 5G, Nothing Phone 4a Pro and OnePlus Nord 6 based on their price and specifications.
title: Oppo F33 Pro 5G vs OnePlus Nord 6 vs Nothing Phone 4a Pro: Price in India, Specifications Compared
